## PR submission rules

- ✅ Original code and documentation only; MIT applies only to project-author code.
- ❌ No official game files (BRF/SCO/DDS/EXE/DLL/audio/fonts/game text/data).
- ❌ No decompiled, cracked, or otherwise unlawfully extracted content.
- ❌ No requests to bundle or distribute official game files.

PRs violating these rules will be closed. Violating any compliance rule leads to project
termination and repository deletion.
